types.name: AgentMandate
docs: A scoped, revocable spending mandate that a human sponsor issues to one agent.
This is a separate onchain authorization object. It never gives the agent
control of the sponsor's wallet; it only describes what the agent may spend.
PDA seeds: ["mandate", sponsor, mandate_id.to_le_bytes()]
All amounts are in base units of `usdc_mint` (for USDC with 6 decimals,
1_000_000 = 1 USDC). All timestamps are unix seconds from the Clock sysvar.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Human owner. Only this key may create, revoke or update the mandate.

fields.name: agent
docs: The one key authorized to spend under this mandate.

fields.name: mandate_id
docs: Sponsor-chosen ID; part of the PDA seeds so one sponsor can hold many mandates.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The single token mint this mandate covers.

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: Maximum amount for any single transaction.

fields.name: max_total
docs: Maximum lifetime spend under this mandate.

fields.name: total_spent
docs: Running total already spent. Only ever increased, using checked math.

fields.name: daily_cap
docs: Maximum spend per day bucket.

fields.name: daily_spent
docs: Amount spent in the day bucket recorded in `current_day`.

fields.name: current_day
docs: Day bucket (unix_timestamp / 86_400) of the last recorded spend.
When the bucket changes, `daily_spent` resets to zero.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp after which the mandate can no longer be used.

fields.name: revoked
docs: Kill switch. Once true, the mandate can never be used again.

fields.name: allowed_recipients
docs: Wallets the agent may pay. Capped at 5 for the MVP; the account is
allocated at full size, so there is no reallocation to get wrong.

types.name: InitializeMandateParams
docs: Arguments for creating a mandate. All amounts are in base units of the mint.
The agent and the mint are passed as accounts, not arguments.

types.name: MandateCreated
docs: Emitted when a sponsor creates a new mandate.

types.name: MandateRevoked
docs: Emitted when a sponsor permanently revokes a mandate.

types.name: SpendRecorded
docs: Emitted when a spend is recorded against a mandate.

fields.name: total_spent
docs: Running total after this spend was added.

constants.name: MANDATE_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix. Full seeds: ["mandate", sponsor pubkey, mandate_id as u64 little-endian bytes].
